UseCaseName: Subscription Renewal Payment and Cancellation Processing
Preconditions: Subscriber must have an active subscription.
Subscription plan information and a previously registered payment method must already exist in the system.
MainSuccessScenario: Subscriber checks the current subscription status and the next billing date on the subscription management screen.
Subscriber applies an owned coupon to adjust the renewal payment amount.
Subscriber taps the renew button to request payment.
The system forwards the registered payment method information to the Payment Gateway to request payment.
The Payment Gateway returns the payment authorization result to the system.
The system updates the subscription information according to the authorization result and issues an invoice.
The system sends a payment completion notification and the invoice to the Subscriber.
The system records the payment details in the settlement ledger so the Billing/Settlement Team can review them.
Extensions: 3a. If the Subscriber enters an invalid coupon code or applies an already-expired coupon, the system rejects the coupon and requests re-entry.
5a. If the Payment Gateway declines the payment authorization, the system schedules up to 3 retries at 24-hour intervals and sends a payment failure notification to the Subscriber.
5b. If all 3 retries fail, the system automatically downgrades the subscription to the free tier and sends a downgrade notice to the Subscriber.

8a. If the Subscriber requests immediate cancellation right after a successful payment, the system calculates the prorated refund amount based on days used and requests a refund from the Payment Gateway.
Postconditions: The subscription status, invoice, and settlement ledger are all updated to their latest state.
The Subscriber has received a notification about the payment outcome.
